text:
Samira (CEO): Quick weekly note — focusing this week on three concrete items: 1) tighten latency guardrails for hosted API, 2) finalize Private GA launch playbook, 3) roll out the updated data-retention policy. Short and specific asks below. :memo:

Samira (CEO): Metrics snapshot (last 7d): p50 token latency ~48ms, p95 ~370ms, error rate ~0.28%, cost/unit drifting +2% vs. target. We need measurable progress next week on p95 and cost.

Alex (VP Eng): On latency guardrails — runtime team will push two changes: kernel selection priority update and a KV-cache TTL tweak. Plan: canary to 5% traffic tonight, 20% tomorrow, 100% if stable. Rollback window 2h. I'll post the canary link in eng-runtime.

Alex (VP Eng): Quick snippet of the rollout command we'll use for visibility:
```
./deploy --service=runtime --version=2026-03-23-latency-patch --canary=5
```

Jia (VP Product): Private GA playbook: marketing comms ready, solutions templates in docs almost done. Need SRE sign-off on the canary checklist (network, KMS, audit logs) by Fri EOD. Also noting enterprise customers want a non-quantized model option — add to must-test list.

Matt (Head SRE): Incident summary from last Thursday (quick recap): brief EU region tail latency spike during a model swap. Root cause: stale affinity routing table causing uneven batching distribution. Mitigation applied: forced rebalancer + expiring stale entries. Postmortem draft in #incidents, ETA for final by Tue.

Matt (Head SRE): Action items from the incident: 1) add health checks to the affinity cache (in progress), 2) automated rebalancer threshold lowered from 30s -> 10s, 3) alert rule tuned to surface skew before p95 moves.

ops-bot: Deploybot: deploy 2026-03-23-latency-patch initiated by Alex at 1761234600. Canary 5% started. Link: https://deploys.redwood/status/1761234600 :rocket:

Samira (CEO): Asks (who/when):
- Alex: confirm canary telemetry (p50/p95/error/cost) posted to the exec dashboard by tomorrow 10:00 PT.
- Matt: confirm SRE checklist items for Private GA (especially KMS + audit retention) by Fri 17:00 PT.
- Jia: finalize customer comms + rollout calendar, include fallback statement and SLA language, by Fri noon.

Samira (CEO): Policy note: we are rolling ~data-retention v2 next Monday (opt-in for longer retention for enterprise with EULA and billing). Legal + Security have signoff; I'll pin the high-level doc in #policy. Any concerns, flag now — we need to ship the contract text to sales by EOD Friday.

Alex (VP Eng): Acknowledged. Will post the telemetry dashboard link as soon as the canary hits steady-state.

Matt (Head SRE): Acknowledged — will push the checklist PR and tag @Jia for product review.

Jia (VP Product): Thanks — will incorporate the rollback wording and non-quantized model option.

Samira (CEO): Final: no surprises. Keep messages short in threads, escalate early. I'll run a 15-minute standup with Eng/SRE/Product Monday 09:00 PT to validate the playbook and metrics. :calendar: If you can't make it, DM me the blocker.

Alex (VP Eng): :thumbsup:

Matt (Head SRE): :thumbsup:

Jia (VP Product): :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploybot: canary reached 20% at 1761234800, no regressions observed.

Samira (CEO): Thanks team — let's tighten those numbers. More updates in Monday standup.
